title: Behavior
description: Process-behavior verdict judged from an existing audit envelope (commands_run, vendor, declaration) after the fact. Behavior specs are hidden from worker prompts — they are never injected into implementer or auditor prompts. Skills tell the agent what to do; behaviors grade whether it did. adherence violated requires at least one evidence_ref; n/a with no evidence_refs is valid.

trigger.description: When this behavior applies, as a condition on the envelope or plan.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers at the existing audit envelope. Required and non-empty when adherence is violated.

allOf.description: A violated verdict must cite at least one evidence_ref on the envelope.

uri.description: Relative path, git SHA, or Firebase Storage signed URL

captured_by.description: Agent or tool that captured the evidence
